historical_timing_context.budget_rationale: The 83 matched passing original cases total 14.628461681 seconds and include the unchanged bounded synthetic DSP workload in the actual core file. A 55-second TERM point allows about 40 seconds above that retained case-duration sum for 49 newly authored, bounded storage/controller/DOM and fake-native PDF seam cases, five-file startup and timing variability; the fixed 5-second KILL grace gives a 60-second project wall budget. The two fixed Node identity calls each have a separate 10-second limit. Immutable source and working-byte custody uses independent Python/Git reads outside the project budget. Historical case durations are not a future wall-time guarantee. Original full-source failure and native/audio holds remain unchanged.

scope: One explicit five-file focused serial TAP selection, 132 source-derived cases. Original cumulative Pre-gig adapter, controller and screen, actual strict-text and PDF/DOM consumers and unchanged bounded synthetic DSP cases in the original core test file. The PDF case uses the real JavaScript adapter with a fake native command boundary. No full suite, build/verifier, browser/native app launch, physical-audio collector, scanner/probe, extracted implementation, separate project command, rerun or additional instrumentation.
